description: KKT residuals (primal/dual feasibility, strong duality, complementary slackness) for the clarabel-MPFR operator-selection LP, computed at 50 dps from decimal-string inputs and the solver's own *_str outputs. Oracle-free validation of the no-float64 path.
caveats: Validates the 50-dps LP solve WITHOUT a second solver. Replaces the 'cross-check against scipy to 1e-25' note on solve_..._mpfr, which is not achievable: the scipy/HiGHS reference is float64 and good to ~1e-16, so 1e-25 agreement against it is not a statement that can be made. The existing f64 cross-check (clarabel_lp_crosscheck.py, 13/13, worst 2.00e-12) remains valid at ITS tolerance. Here every input is a decimal string and every operation runs under mp.workdps(50), so no float64 enters. The H_3 atom LP is DEGENERATE (y0 ~ -6.6e-19), so r_gap and r_cs are absolute residuals on near-zero objectives — read them against term_scale, not alone. Bean qou-q7f1.
